title: MEDTRUM / Empty reservoir when pod is deactivated
body:
Minor Medtrum bug. No active pod but the tab says that there is still insulin available. 
I think that, once the pod has been deactivated,  the insulin in it is "lost" and could be set to 0.

![Screenshot_20240507_215200_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/50fee573-3042-4bac-8e81-69390a28ff0c)

comments.body: Should we reset the others too? Last bolus, pump battery and Expiration date
